title: Beijing flips the script on the U.S. tech war — and tests the truce weeks before Xi's visit
summary_full: China unleashed its broadest package of trade countermeasures since last October's trade truce, pushing back against a string of recent U.S. restrictions.
summary_public: China unleashed its broadest package of trade countermeasures since last October's trade truce, pushing back against a string of recent U.S. restrictions.
